prompt: In chess, a knight moves in an L shape: two squares in one direction and then one square to the side. A knight sits alone on corner square a1 of an otherwise empty board. How many squares can it move to?
explanation: From the corner most L-shaped moves fall off the board. Only two land on the board: b3 (one file across, two ranks up) and c2 (two files across, one rank up).
